statement: Mail dedup rule: Message-ID merges only with same sender, same normalized subject and dates within two days; content-hash/composite evidence never merges two different Message-IDs; dedup links observations and never deletes them. Both earlier looser variants merged distinct emails in tests/benchmark.
task_summary: Mail bootstrap (EarthLink + iCloud, read-only, multi-account) implemented on branch mail-multi-account (34f72aa5, 1076523a). 53 mail/ingestion tests pass; full suite only fails the 3 known worktree-path tests plus a pre-existing upstream project-count test.
